title: Layer-2 Rollups & Zero-Knowledge Cryptography
description: Master off-chain scaling with Optimistic Rollups, ZK-SNARKs, state fraud proofs, and modular blockchains.

questions.question: In Layer-2 scaling solutions, how do 'Rollups' (Optimistic or ZK) scale throughput on base chains (Layer 1)?
options: By executing transactions off-chain and posting aggregated proofs and compressed data to Layer 1
By deleting older historical transactions after 30 days
By replacing public cryptography with shared enterprise passwords
By requiring miners to double their GPU clock frequencies

questions.question: What does 'Zero-Knowledge Proof' (ZKP) allow one party to prove to another?
options: That a statement is true without revealing any information beyond the validity of the statement itself
That the sender has zero tokens in their wallet
That the network contains zero latency between peer nodes
That a database table contains zero rows

questions.question: What is the core difference between Optimistic Rollups and ZK-Rollups?
options: Optimistic assumes transactions are valid unless challenged via fraud proofs; ZK uses cryptographic validity proofs (SNARKs/STARKs)
Optimistic rollups do not connect to Ethereum Layer 1
ZK-Rollups take 7 days for transaction finality while Optimistic takes 1 millisecond
Optimistic rollups can only process Bitcoin payments

questions.question: What is the 'Data Availability Problem' in modular rollup architectures?
options: Ensuring all nodes have access to the underlying transaction data needed to reconstruct and verify the state
Running out of disk space on local mobile wallets
Restricting internet access in developing regions
Encrypting hard drives before shipping to data centers

questions.question: What is a 'Sybil Attack' on peer-to-peer distributed networks?
options: An adversary subverting the network by creating multiple pseudo-identities to gain disproportionate influence
Stealing private keys by eavesdropping on Bluetooth headsets
Deleting CSS stylesheets from a frontend CDN
Overheating cooling fans on ASIC mining equipment
